newsitem.title: UK: Harlow Butler says expands Norwegian operation.
newsitem.headline: Harlow Butler says expands Norwegian operation.

text.p: UK broking firm Harlow Butler said on Thursday it had been granted a securities licence and become a member of the Oslo stock exchange.
"Harlow Butler has become the first local broker to trade Norwegian government bonds, T-bills and repo exclusively on a name give-up basis," it said in a statement.

Harlow Butler, which is owned by United News & Media, said the introduction of a new service in Norwegian government bonds fitted well with its strategy of developing Scandinavian products and expanding its involvement in broking European and other government bonds and Eurobonds.
Harlow said the new section would be headed by Frode Borhaug who previously traded for Christiania Securities.
